tickerText: [TENNIS] Shelton defends Montreal title 6-3, 7-6(4) over Nakashima — first back-to-back Canadian Open champ since Nadal, unbeaten through the draw • [SQUASH] Kolkata PSA Challenger finals today: Gohar vs Refaay and Hazem vs Walid after Indian seeds Khanna and Chand exit in semis; Valencia semis also on court in Spain • [BADMINTON] BWF Worlds kick off in Delhi Aug 17 — defending champ Shi Yu Qi faces home hope Ayush Shetty in a blockbuster R1 at Indira Gandhi Arena • [PICKLEBALL] Seattle PPA Challenger opens today at Sideout Tsunami with $10K purses across five pro disciplines through Sunday • [TABLE TENNIS] Singles quarter-finals underway at WTT Europe Smash Malmö; wildcard Ranefur stunned No. 12 Wen 3-2 as Wang Manyu eyes the last four

newsItems.title: Shelton Repeats in Montreal
newsItems.excerpt: Ben Shelton beat Brandon Nakashima 6-3, 7-6(4) to defend his National Bank Open crown — the first man to win back-to-back Canadian titles since Rafael Nadal in 2019.

newsItems.title: Delhi Worlds Three Days Out
newsItems.excerpt: The BWF World Championships open Aug 17 at Indira Gandhi Arena — defending champ Shi Yu Qi faces India's Ayush Shetty in a blockbuster R1 as India hosts for the first time in 17 years.

newsItems.title: Seattle Challenger Begins
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Seattle Challenger opens today at Sideout Tsunami Pickleball Center — a Challengers 250 stop with $10,000 purses across five pro disciplines through Aug 16.

newsItems.title: QF Day in Malmö
newsItems.excerpt: Singles quarter-finals are underway at the WTT Europe Smash in Malmö — wildcard Elias Ranefur stunned No. 12 Ruibo Wen 3-2 while Wang Manyu pushes for the last four after her injury return.
